news.contents: Updating a previous report, Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua (knee) needed surgery on his MCL and will likely miss the rest of the season, head coach Sean McVay told Adam Grosbard of the Los Angeles Daily News. Nacua was placed on Injured Reserve with a strained MCL and PCL, as well as a turf-toe injury, but the Rams were hoping that he would be able to return after missing the required four games.
